A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Flexpert study. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices A–K are available and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original flexibility-prediction and protein-design evaluations on ATLAS, mdCATH, and CATH4.3, including ablations, structural analyses, and failure cases.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical evaluations in Sections 5.1–5.2 and the appendices, with revised predictor scores in Tables 2–3.

M1.justification: The ProtTrans/LoRA predictors, ANM adaptor, flexibility-conditioned ProteinMPNN, combined losses, and Gumbel-Softmax procedure are retained. Redrawn architecture diagrams clarify the existing method without establishing a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions use ATLAS, CATH4.3, and mdCATH with the same prediction, flexibility-increase/decrease, temperature-shift, and structure-preservation tasks. No dataset or distinct test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged, including AlphaFold2, ESMFold, GNM, ANM, vanilla ProteinMPNN, and the loss variants. Shortening GNM/ANM labels does not change their documented inputs or identity.

E3.justification: Table 1 revises the stated sample from 1390 to 1383/1390 proteins, explaining missing-structure exclusions. Appendix H changes additional fine-tuning from 8–9 to 8–11 epochs while retaining 12 hours on one GPU. These are reported setting revisions; they do not establish that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The B-factor training comparison, input-structure analysis, mdCATH temperature tests, qualitative cases, loss-weight ablation, structure-preservation analysis, parameter sensitivity, and flexibility-decrease experiment are retained with the same evidence.

E5.justification: The three ATLAS simulation replicas and their correlation analysis remain unchanged. Neither version introduces additional training-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance-testing procedures.

E6.justification: Table 2 revises MD correlations for AlphaFold2/ESMFold/Flexpert-Seq from 0.71/0.57/0.76 to 0.72/0.58/0.78. Table 3 changes ANM/Flexpert-3D correlations with MD from 0.77/0.82 to 0.76/0.83, and GNM/Flexpert-3D correlations with ANM from 0.94/0.81 to 0.93/0.78. These are limited score revisions with broadly retained conclusions; Tables 4–10 remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The formal model definitions, assumptions, losses, enrichment ratio, RMSF formulas, and B-factor normalization remain unchanged, including Equations 1–11. No theorem, proof, or substantive derivation is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same three contributions: comparing flexibility measurements, learning flexibility predictors, and steering inverse folding toward increased predicted flexibility. The scope of the principal claims is unchanged.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the interpretations concerning sequence/structure complementarity, temperature generalization, structural changes after engineering, and difficulty decreasing flexibility. Appendix F is reworded without changing its explanation or applicability boundaries.

D1.justification: Tables 2–3 newly specify 139 ATLAS test proteins, Table 1 explains exclusions, and Appendix H revises the documented epoch range. The reproducibility statement changes code and instructions for obtaining data and trained weights from forthcoming to available at the same repository; availability is asserted by the PDF, not independently verified.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive research positioning are unchanged. Naming AlphaFlow explicitly in v2 identifies the already-discussed and cited Jing et al. work rather than adding a new research comparison.

P1.justification: v2 groups former Sections 3.3–3.4 under a dedicated Methods heading and renumbers subsequent sections. Local copyediting, expanded figure explanations, updated affiliations/publication headers, and acknowledgements accompany this limited structural refinement.

P2.justification: Figures 1–2 are redrawn with clearer arrows and legends explaining trainable/fixed modules and frozen/unfrozen layers. Tables 1–3 have simplified labels, Table 1 changes highlighting, and several appendix displays relocate. Figure 3 receives a legend correction; the remaining result graphics are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves clarity and reproducibility documentation through the dedicated Methods section, clearer architecture diagrams, explicit evaluation sample counts, and reported resource availability. These gains are tempered by unexplained score revisions and stale ATLAS scores in Appendices D and F: they retain 0.76/0.82 despite updated Tables 2–3. The overall benefit is limited and comes from clearer reporting, not the higher reported scores.
